Remodeled Two-Level 3-Bedroom Mission Cottage with Garage, Storage & Laundry
Located at 19th Street and Capp Street in the heart of the Mission, this beautifully remodeled two-level cottage offers three bedrooms, 1.5 bathrooms, and the privacy and separation of space that is hard to find in a typical San Francisco rental.
Just one block from the Valencia Street corridor, the home is surrounded by some of San Francisco's most popular restaurants, cafes, bars, shops, and neighborhood amenities, with Dolores Park just a short walk away.
The location is exceptionally convenient, with a Walk Score of 99 and Bike Score of 94. Both the 16th Street and 24th Street Mission BART stations are easily accessible, along with multiple nearby Muni lines.
Home Features:
Private two-level cottageThree bedrooms with generous closet space - two bedrooms upstairs and one bedroom downstairs1.5 bathroomsRemodeled gourmet kitchenStainless steel appliancesGas range, refrigerator, dishwasher and microwaveOpen living and dining area with excellent natural lightHardwood floors throughoutHigh ceilingsPrivate washer and dryer located downstairsLarge private storage space included in rentPrivate garage parking for one car included in rentMove-in readyNo pets, sorryOne-month security deposit.
